Title: 1. Raiders of the Lost Ark
description: In 1936, archaeologist Indiana Jones is tasked by Army Intelligence to help locate a legendary ancient power, the Ark of Covenant, before the Nazis get it first.

Title: 2. On Golden Pond
description: Curmudgeon Norman is estranged from his daughter Chelsea. Nevertheless, at Golden Pond he and his wife agree to look after Billy, the son of Chelsea's new boyfriend, and a most unexpected relationship blooms.

Title: 3. Porky's
description: In 1954, a group of Florida high school guys vow revenge after being harassed by a sleazy nightclub owner and his redneck sheriff brother.

Title: 4. Arthur
description: Alcoholic billionaire playboy Arthur Bach must marry a woman he does not love, or he will be cut off from his $750,000,000 fortune. But when Arthur falls in love with a poor waitress, he must decide if he wants to choose love or money.

Title: 5. Stripes
description: Two friends who are dissatisfied with their jobs decide to join the Army for a bit of fun.

Title: 6. The Cannonball Run
description: A wide variety of eccentric competitors participate in a wild and illegal cross-country road race. However, the eccentric entrants will do anything to win the road race, including low-down, dirty tricks.

Title: 7. The Fox and the Hound
description: A fox named Tod and a hound named Copper vow to be best friends forever. But as Copper grows into a hunting dog, their unlikely friendship faces the ultimate test.

Title: 8. Chariots of Fire
description: Two British track athletes, one a determined Jew and the other a devout Christian, are driven to win in the 1924 Olympics as they wrestle with issues of pride and conscience.

Title: 9. For Your Eyes Only
description: Secret service agent James Bond is assigned to find a missing British vessel equipped with a weapons encryption device and prevent it from falling into enemy hands.

Title: 10. The Four Seasons
description: Witty character study of three couples who vacation together each season. After one divorces, feelings of betrayal and more spawn criticisms of one another, but things that unite them are stronger than those which might pull them apart.

Title: 11. Time Bandits
description: A young boy accidentally joins a band of time travelling dwarves, as they jump from era to era looking for treasure to steal.

Title: 12. Clash of the Titans
description: Perseus must battle Medusa and the Kraken to save the Princess Andromeda.

Title: 13. Absence of Malice
description: When prosecutor Elliot Rosen leaks to naive, but well-meaning, Miami reporter Megan Carter that liquor wholesaler Mike Gallagher is suspected in the murder of the local longshoreman union president, Gallagher's life begins to unravel.

Title: 14. Reds
description: A radical American journalist becomes involved with the Communist revolution in Russia, and hopes to bring its spirit and idealism to the United States.

Title: 15. Tarzan the Ape Man
description: While on an African expedition with her father, Jane Parker meets Tarzan, and the two become fascinated by each other.

Title: 16. Taps
description: Military cadets take extreme measures to ensure the future of their academy when its existence is threatened by local condo developers.

Title: 17. Sharky's Machine
description: Tom Sharky is demoted to vice after a bust goes terribly wrong. He and his team stumble across a mob murder tied to prostitution and government.

Title: 18. Excalibur
description: Merlin the magician helps Arthur Pendragon unite the Britons around the Round Table of Camelot, even as dark forces conspire to tear it apart.

Title: 19. History of the World: Part I
description: Mel Brooks brings his one-of-a-kind comic touch to the history of mankind covering events from the Old Testament to the French Revolution in a series of episodic comedy vignettes.

Title: 20. Bustin' Loose
description: Failed parolee Joe Braxton has one last shot at redemption: by driving school kids from Philadelphia to Washington State.

Title: 21. The Great Muppet Caper
description: Kermit the Frog, The Great Gonzo, and Fozzie Bear are reporters who travel to Britain to interview a rich victim of jewel thieves and help her along with her secretary, Miss Piggy.

Title: 22. Endless Love
description: Parental disapproval of a passionate romance between teenagers Jade Butterfield and David Axelrod leads to arguments, circumstance, insanity and tragedy.

Title: 23. An American Werewolf in London
description: Two American college students are on a walking tour of Britain when they are attacked by a werewolf whose existence is consistently denied by the locals.

Title: 24. Neighbors
description: A quiet man's peaceful suburban lifestyle is threatened by the obnoxious new couple who moves in next next door.

Title: 25. Fort Apache the Bronx
description: In New York City, South Bronx's main police precinct is nicknamed Fort Apache by its employees who feel like troopers surrounded by hostiles in a wild west isolated outpost.

Title: 26. The French Lieutenant's Woman
description: Anna and Mike portray two characters in a film set in 19th century England who fall in love despite the fact that Mike's character is engaged.

Title: 27. Private Lessons
description: An immigrant housemaid seduces a 15-year-old boy and later fakes her own death as part of his chauffeur's blackmail plot. Troubles arise when the two start to fall in love.

Title: 28. Modern Problems
description: Jealous, harried air traffic controller Max Fiedler, recently dumped by his girlfriend, comes into contact with nuclear waste and is granted the power of telekinesis, which he uses not only to win her back, but to gain a little revenge.

Title: 29. Halloween II
description: While Dr. Loomis hunts for Michael Myers, a traumatized Laurie is rushed to Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, and The Shape is not far behind her.

Title: 30. Only When I Laugh
description: A Broadway actress fresh out of rehab navigates sobriety, her career, demanding daughter, and supporting her troubled friends' personal crises.

Title: 31. Escape from New York
description: In a dystopian 1997, a soldier-turned-bank robber is tasked with rescuing the U.S. President after he crashes into Manhattan, which has been turned into a giant maximum security prison.

Title: 32. Body Heat
description: During an extreme heatwave, a beautiful Florida woman and a seedy lawyer engage in an affair while plotting the murder of her rich husband.

Title: 33. The Road Warrior
description: In the post-apocalyptic Australian wasteland, a cynical drifter agrees to help a small, gasoline-rich community get rid of a horde of bandits.

Title: 34. Ghost Story
description: Two generations of men find themselves haunted by the presence of a spectral woman. When the son of one of the elderly men returns to his hometown after his brother's mysterious death, they attempt to unravel her story.

Title: 35. Friday the 13th: Part 2
description: Five years after the events of the first film, a summer camp next to the infamous Camp Crystal Lake is preparing to open, but the legend of Jason is weighing heavy on the proceedings.

Title: 36. Quest for Fire
description: This story takes place in prehistoric time when three tribesmen search for a new fire source.

Title: 37. The Final Conflict
description: The now adult Antichrist plots to eliminate his future divine opponent while a cabal of monks plot to stop him.

Title: 38. The Incredible Shrinking Woman
description: A housewife grows smaller and smaller in reaction to chemicals found in cosmetics and household products.

Title: 39. Mommie Dearest
description: The abusive and traumatic adoptive upbringing of Christina Crawford at the hands of her mother, screen queen Joan Crawford, is depicted.

Title: 40. Paternity
description: A single man searches for a woman who will bear his baby with no strings attached.

Title: 41. Under the Rainbow
description: A visiting dignitary, a CIA agent, a Nazi spy, Japanese tourists, an assassin and a group of "midget" actors from The Wizard of Oz (1939) all check into an elite Los Angeles hotel called Under the Rainbow.

Title: 42. The Howling
description: After a bizarre and near deadly encounter with a serial killer, a television newswoman is sent to a remote mountain resort whose residents may not be what they seem.

Title: 43. Eye of the Needle
description: A ruthless German spy, trying to get out of Britain with vital information about D-Day, must spend time with a young woman and her crippled husband.

Title: 44. Take This Job and Shove It
description: Frank is sent to his native town, Millsborough, to increase the local brewery production. He meets old school mates and his former girlfriend, Jane. They quickly fall in love again. Frank is torn between his job.

Title: 45. Outland
description: A federal marshal newly stationed at a mining colony on the Jupiter moon of Io notices a series of unusual deaths. Against the advice of everyone, he digs deeper to find the cause, and finds himself marked for death.

Title: 46. The Devil and Max Devlin
description: Max, a dead corrupt businessman, makes a Faustian pact with Satan's henchman to drive three people to Hell in exchange for longer life. Soon Max realizes that there still may be good in him.

Title: 47. Caveman
description: A caveman seeks revenge on a much larger competitor for the hand of a beautiful cavewoman.

Title: 48. Continental Divide
description: A hard-nosed Chicago journalist has an unlikely love affair with an eagle researcher.

Title: 49. The Night the Lights Went Out in Georgia
description: A small-town stud wants to go to Nashville to be a big country star. His ambitious kid sister works as his manager. Their dream hits jeopardy when they cross paths with a small-town sheriff.

Title: 50. Ragtime
description: A young black pianist becomes embroiled in the lives of an upper-class white family set among the racial tensions, infidelity, violence and other tumultuous events of early 1900s New York City.

Title: 51. Nighthawks
description: When one of Europe's most lethal terrorists shows up in New York, an elite undercover cop is assigned to take him down by any means necessary.

Title: 52. S.O.B.
description: A successful movie director makes the most expensive film in his career and it becomes a huge flop. He tries to salvage his career by reshooting the film as an erotic production, where its family-friendly star takes her top off.

Title: 53. Rich and Famous
description: Liz and Merry become BFFs in college. A decade later, Liz is a serious writer with writer's block, and Merry is a homemaker and a mom who has written a novel. Other bestsellers, riches, and fame follow.

Title: 54. Scanners
description: A scientist trains a man with an advanced telepathic ability called "scanning" to stop a dangerous Scanner with extraordinary psychic powers from waging war against non-Scanners.

Title: 55. Dragonslayer
description: A young wizarding apprentice is sent to kill a dragon which has been devouring girls from a nearby kingdom.

Title: 56. True Confessions
description: A worldly ambitious monsignor clashes with his older brother, a cynical Los Angeles homicide detective who is investigating the brutal murder of a young prostitute.

Title: 57. The Legend of the Lone Ranger
description: The sole surviving Texas Ranger (Klinton Spilsbury) of an ambush arranged by outlaw leader Major Bartholomew "Butch" Cavendish (Christopher Lloyd) returns to fight back as a great masked western hero, The Lone Ranger.

Title: 58. First Monday in October
description: For the first time in history a woman is appointed to the U.S. Supreme Court, where she becomes a friendly rival to a liberal associate.

Title: 59. The Postman Always Rings Twice
description: The sensuous wife of a roadside diner proprietor and a rootless drifter begin a sordid, steamy affair and conspire to murder her Greek husband.

Title: 60. Blow Out
description: A movie sound recordist accidentally records the evidence that proves that a car accident was actually murder and consequently finds himself in danger.

Title: 61. Comin' at Ya!
description: An ex-bank robber embarks on a quest to save his bride after she is kidnapped by a pair of outlaw brothers hoping to auction her and dozens of other abducted women off to Mexican brothels.

Title: 62. Back Roads
description: A prostitute and a drifter find themselves bound together as they make their way through the rural South, doing what they have to do to survive.

Title: 63. Thief
description: After a long prison sentence, a top safe-cracker takes over a couple of businesses that he uses as fronts for diamond heists. After his trusted fence is killed, he agrees to work with a powerful mobster resulting in dire consequences.

Title: 64. Das Boot
description: During World War II, a German U-boat crew embarks on a perilous Atlantic patrol, confronting enemy attacks, isolation, and the crushing strain of life underwater.

Title: 65. Victory
description: As allied P.O.W.s prepare for a soccer game against the German National Team to be played in Nazi-occupied Paris, the French Resistance and British officers are making plans for the team's escape.

Title: 66. Rollover
description: The wife of a murdered petrochemical company chairman and a banker investigating the liquidity of his new bank stumble upon an international financial scheme that could lead to global economic collapse.

Title: 67. Wolfen
description: A New York cop investigates a series of brutal deaths that resemble animal attacks.

Title: 68. Carbon Copy
description: When a rich white corporate executive finds out that he has an illegitimate black son, things start falling apart for him at home, work, and in his social circles.

Title: 69. Pennies from Heaven
description: During the Great Depression, a sheet-music salesman seeks to escape his dreary life through popular music and a love affair with an innocent schoolteacher.

Title: 70. Deadly Blessing
description: After her husband dies under suspicious circumstances, a young woman living in a rural area becomes increasingly paranoid of the neighboring religious community. When two of her friends come to stay with her, death seems to follow.

Title: 71. Whose Life Is It Anyway?
description: Ken Harrison is an artist who makes sculptures. One day he is involved in a car accident, and is paralyzed from his neck down. All he can do is talk, and he wants to die. In hospital he make friends with some of the staff, and they support him when he goes to trial to be allowed to die.

Title: 72. Prince of the City
description: A New York City narcotics detective reluctantly agrees to cooperate with a special commission investigating police corruption, and soon realises he's in over his head, and nobody can be trusted.

Title: 73. The Funhouse
description: Teenage Amy Harper, her boyfriend Buzz Dawson, and their friends Richie Atterbury and Liz Duncan visit a local carnival for a night of innocent amusement, but soon witness a fortune teller's murder and find that the exits are locked.

Title: 74. Buddy Buddy
description: During a high-profile Mafia testimony case in California's Riverside County, a hired killer checks into a hotel room near the courthouse, while his depressed next-door neighbor wants to commit suicide over marital problems.

Title: 75. The Amateur
description: A CIA computer expert goes abroad for revenge after terrorists execute his girlfriend in Munich.

Title: 76. ...All the Marbles
description: Small-time female wrestling team "The California Dolls" and their manager must face the hardships of their sport and their lives to succeed.

Title: 77. Eyewitness
description: A janitor who claims he's seen a murder becomes romantically involved with the glamorous TV reporter covering the story.

Title: 78. Gallipoli
description: Two Australian sprinters face the brutal realities of war when they are sent to fight in the Gallipoli campaign in Turkey during World War I.

Title: 79. My Bloody Valentine
description: A decades-old folk tale surrounding a deranged murderer killing those who celebrate Valentine's Day turns out to be true to legend when a group defies the killer's order and people start turning up dead.

Title: 80. Going Ape!
description: When 80-year-old Max Sabatini dies, he leaves his three prized orangutans in the care of his only son, Foster. To inherit his father's $5-million fortune, Foster must take care of the apes for the next five years.

Title: 81. Venom
description: Terrorists in the process of kidnapping a child get trapped in a house with an extremely deadly snake.

Title: 82. Inchon
description: During the Korean War, General Douglas MacArthur masterminds the amphibious invasion of Inchon in September 1950.

Title: 83. Student Bodies
description: A serial killer with his signature heavy breathing proceeds to systematically kill the students and teachers of Lamab high school.

Title: 84. All Night Long
description: A middle-aged executive's lifestyle and values are turned upside down after he is demoted to chain-store night manager.

Title: 85. The Pursuit of D.B. Cooper
description: D.B. Cooper parachutes with his stolen money and proceeds to contact his wife. Meanwhile, his former army sergeant, who now works as an insurance investigator, manages to identify him and decides to track him down.

Title: 86. Zoot Suit
description: When barrio leader Henry Reyna and his friends are unjustly convicted on circumstantial evidence, activist lawyers Alice Bloomfield and George Shearer fight the blatant racially motivated miscarriage of justice to win them their freedom.

Title: 87. The Fan
description: Douglas, a record salesman, is an obsessive fan of actress Sally Ross. When his letters are rejected, he strikes out at her and her loved ones.

Title: 88. Gas
description: Chaos besets a town when the populace hears of a gas shortage. Reporter Jane Beardsley investigates stolen milk causing milk prices and gas prices to rise. Others get involved, leading to a big car chase. Howie Mandel's screen debut.

Title: 89. Modern Romance
description: Albert Brooks directs himself as a successful film editor with far too many issues that affects the relationship between him and his remarkably patient girlfriend.

Title: 90. The Hand
description: A comic book artist loses his hand, which in turn takes on a murderous life of its own.

Title: 91. The Evil Dead
description: Five friends travel to a cabin in the woods, where they unknowingly release flesh-possessing demons.

Title: 92. Heartbeeps
description: Two household robots run away and try to start a family.

Title: 93. This Is Elvis
description: The life and career of Elvis Presley are chronicled in home movies, concert footage, and dramatizations.

Title: 94. Sphinx
description: Egyptologist Erica Baron finds more than she bargained for during her long-planned trip to The Land of the Pharoahs: murder, theft, betrayal, love, and a mummy's curse.

Title: 95. Honky Tonk Freeway
description: A satire of American progression in which a mayor tries to bribe an official to ensure a ramp connects Ticlaw to an up-and-coming intrastate. When his plan fails, the town residents are forced to take matters into their own hands.

Title: 96. Raggedy Man
description: A divorcee with two sons has an affair with a young sailor passing through her Texas town in 1944.

Title: 97. King of the Mountain
description: A group of friends race their high-powered cars up and down a dangerous and deadly mountain road known as Mulholland Drive to see who can claim the title of "King of the Mountain."

Title: 98. Cutter's Way
description: Richard spots a man dumping a body, and decides to expose the man he thinks is the culprit with his friend Alex Cutter.

Title: 99. Silence of the North
description: Based on the biography of Olive Fredrickson, It tells of her life as a girl, then a trapper's wife and later a widow with three small children surviving under rugged pioneer conditions in northern Alberta Canada from the early 1900's through to the Depression.

Title: 100. Night School
description: Who's been decapitating the innocent girls at a local night school? The police are baffled.

Title: 101. Possession
description: A woman starts exhibiting increasingly disturbing behavior after asking her husband for a divorce. Suspicions of infidelity soon give way to something much more sinister.

Title: 102. Eyes of a Stranger
description: A vigilant reporter investigates a suspicious neighbor after a serial killer stalks women across Miami, but her search for proof draws the killer toward her home and her vulnerable sister.

Title: 103. One from the Heart
description: A couple has a fight after living together 5 years in Las Vegas. They go out and celebrate 4th of July, each with a new partner. Breakup?

Title: 104. Heavy Metal
description: A glowing green orb that embodies ultimate evil terrorizes a young girl with an anthology of bizarre and fantastic stories.

Title: 105. Hard Country
description: Ambitious young Jodie wants more out of life than the small Texas country town she lives in has to offer. Jodie realizes that in order to pursue her dreams she will have to leave Texas and move to the big city. However, her shiftless factory worker boyfriend Kyle wants to stay in Texas.

Title: 106. The Weavers: Wasn't That a Time
description: Documentary about the blacklisted folk group, "The Weavers," and the events leading up to their triumphant return to Carnegie Hall.

Title: 107. Man of Iron
description: A few years after the events of Man of Marble (1977), a journalist investigates Mateusz Birkut's son Maciek Tomczyk, now an activist leading a shipyard strike.

Title: 108. Kelly
description: A young girl from a broken home who is having problems in school and her personal life decides to run away and live with her father in the wilderness.

Title: 109. Puberty Blues
description: The mating rituals of two teenage surf chicks from the southern suburbs of Sydney.

Title: 110. Diva
description: Two tapes, two Parisian mob killers, one corrupt policeman, an opera fan, a teenage thief, and the coolest philosopher ever filmed all twist their way through an intricate and stylish French-language thriller.

Title: 111. The Beyond
description: A young woman inherits an old hotel in Louisiana where, following a series of supernatural "accidents", she learns that the building was built over one of the entrances to Hell.

Title: 112. Roar
description: A naturalist living with big cats in East Africa expects a visit by his family of four from Chicago. A mix-up leaves him searching for his family, who have been left in the clutches of wild lions.

Title: 113. The Girl with the Red Hair
description: The story of Hannie Schaft of the Dutch resistance told in flashbacks how she tries to bring collaborators and criminals to justice in 1945.

Title: 114. Stations of the Elevated
description: Stations of the Elevated (1981) is a 45-minute city symphony directed, produced and edited by Manfred Kirchheimer. Shot on lush 16mm color reversal stock, the film weaves together vivid images of graffiti- covered elevated subway trains crisscrossing the gritty urban landscape of 1970s New York, to a commentary-free soundtrack that combines ambient city noise with jazz and gospel by Charles Mingus and Aretha Franklin. Gliding through the South Bronx, Brooklyn, Queens and Manhattan - making a rural detour past a correctional facility upstate - Stations of the Elevated is an impressionistic portrait of and tribute to a New York that has long since disappeared.

Title: 115. Le Pont du Nord
description: Young unhinged female ex-con with a motorcycle helps a sickly young homeless woman in red discover what the map of Paris she took from her gangster boyfriend leads to.

Title: 116. Love & Money
description: A billionaire businessman hires a man to influence a South American dictator. He winds up having an affair with the billionaire's wife.

Title: 117. Quartet
description: Finding herself penniless after her art-dealer husband Stephan is convicted of theft, Marya Zelli accepts the hospitality of a strange couple, H.J. and Lois Heidler, who let her live in their home.

Title: 118. Coup de torchon
description: A pathetic police chief, humiliated by everyone around him, suddenly wants a clean slate in life - and resorts to drastic means to do so.

Title: 119. Lili Marleen
description: In 1938, a German singer falls in love with a Jewish composer in Zurich, who helps Jews flee Nazi Germany. She wants to help but is forced back to Germany. Her song "Lili Marleen" becomes a hit with soldiers and the Nazi top brass.

Title: 120. Lola
description: A cabaret singer corrupts a city planner in 1957 Germany.

Title: 121. My Dinner with Andre
description: Two old friends meet for dinner; as one tells anecdotes detailing his experiences, the other notices their differing worldviews.

Title: 122. The Boat Is Full
description: WWII Switzerland: six refugees jump from a German train and pose as a family in a village inn. A constable's investigation exposes them, forcing a choice over who may stay and who will be deported.

Title: 123. The Pit
description: A bullied and outcast 12-year-old boy makes a disturbing discovery in the depth of a forest. He tells his new babysitter while his parents are away, but she shrugs him off. He finds solace in confiding to his favorite teddy bear.

Title: 124. The Woman Next Door
description: Two ex-lovers wind up living next door to each other with their respective spouses. Forbidden passions ensue.

Title: 125. The Monster Club
description: A horror writer is summoned to a "monster club" by an enigmatic elder. There, three macabre tales unfold before him, interspersed with musical interludes. The convergence of storytelling and performance creates an eerie atmosphere.

Title: 126. Christiane F.
description: A teen girl in 1970s Berlin becomes addicted to heroin. Everything in her life slowly begins to distort and disappear as she befriends a small crew of junkies and falls in love with a drug-abusing male prostitute.

Title: 127. The Burning
description: Abusive former summer camp caretaker Cropsy, horribly burned from a prank gone wrong five years earlier, lurks around upstate NY summer Camp Stonewater with garden shears and bent on killing the teenagers responsible for his disfigurement.

Title: 128. Southern Comfort
description: During a routine exercise, a team of National Guardsmen are threatened by angry and violent locals.

Title: 129. Ms .45
description: After being attacked and raped twice in one day, a timid, mute seamstress takes to the streets of New York City with a .45 caliber pistol and a thirst for revenge.

Title: 130. Happy Birthday to Me
description: At the snobby Crawford Academy, Virginia's group of friends start to go missing years after horrible events that happened to her as a child around her birthday.

Title: 131. Road Games
description: A laid-back American truck driver in south Australia suspects a man with a green van of killing young women along his route, and becomes embroiled in a game of cat-and-mouse to catch him.

Title: 132. Kagero-za
description: A 1920s playwright meets a beautiful woman who may be the ghost of his patron's deceased wife.

Title: 133. Basket Case
description: A young man carrying a big basket that contains his extremely deformed, formerly conjoined twin brother seeks vengeance on the doctors who separated them against their will.

Title: 134. Son of the White Mare
description: In this dreamlike Hungarian folk myth, a horse goddess gives birth to three powerful brothers who set out into the Underworld to save three princesses from three evil dragons and reclaim their ancestors' lost kingdom.

Title: 135. Dead & Buried
description: Sheriff Dan Gillis investigates eerie deaths in a sleepy coastal town.

Title: 136. Stepfather
description: After her mother dies, fourteen-year-old Marion falls in love with her stepfather, Remy.

Title: 137. Cannibal Ferox
description: Three friends embark on a trip through the Amazon jungle to disprove cannibalism, where they meet a pair of fugitive drug smugglers forcing a vicious cannibal tribe to harvest cocaine.

Title: 138. The Professional
description: Victim of a plot which has resulted in his imprisonment in a Central African jail for two years, a French secret agent arrives in Paris to settle accounts.

Title: 139. Knightriders
description: A medieval reenactment troupe struggles to maintain its family-like dynamic amid pressure from local authorities, interest from talent agents, and their "King's" delusions of grandeur.

Title: 140. Butcher, Baker, Nightmare Maker
description: An orphaned teenager finds himself being dominated by his aunt who's hell-bent on keeping him with her at all costs.

Title: 141. Evilspeak
description: An outcast military cadet taps into a way to summon demons and cast spells on his tormentors through his computer.

Title: 142. Mephisto
description: In early-1930s Germany, a passionate stage actor faces a dilemma: renounce his apolitical stance and comply with the Reich's doctrine, or face oblivion. But, Faustian bargains never end well. What is the price of success?

Title: 143. The Prowler
description: An unknown killer, clad in World War II U.S. Army fatigues, stalks a small California town, bent on reliving a 35 year-old double murder by focusing on a group of college kids holding an annual graduation dance.

Title: 144. The Grilling
description: A police inspector, suspecting an attorney of two child sex murders, has him held for a questioning session that goes on for hours.

Title: 145. Shock Treatment
description: Janet and Brad become contestants on a game show and wind up as captives.

Title: 146. American Pop
description: The story of four generations of a Russian Jewish immigrant family of musicians whose careers parallel the history of American popular music in the 20th century.

Title: 147. Just Before Dawn
description: Five young people venture into the backwoods of Oregon to claim a property, and find themselves being stalked by a hulking, machete-wielding psychopath.

Title: 148. The House by the Cemetery
description: A New England home is terrorized by a series of murders, unbeknownst to the guests that a gruesome secret is hiding in the basement.

Title: 149. Hell Night
description: Four college fraternity and sorority pledges spend the night in a deserted old mansion as part of a hazing ritual during hell night, where they are stalked by the only survivor of a family massacre from the mansion's sordid past.

Title: 150. The Being
description: A mutated creature is wreaking havoc in a small town in Idaho. A police chief and a government scientist team up to save their rural town from its menace.

Title: 151. Absurd
description: A priest-doctor chasing a man with supernatural regenerative abilities, who has recently escaped from a medical lab, reaches a small town where the mutant goes on a killing spree.

Title: 152. Graduation Day
description: A masked killer begins to murder students on the school track team after a track runner dies upon completion of a 30-second 200-meter race.

Title: 153. They All Laughed
description: A madcap private-eye caper about a team of detectives who are following, and are being followed by, a group of beautiful women.

Title: 154. The Cabbage Soup
description: 2 buddy farmers are visited by aliens who like their domestic cabbage soup.

Title: 155. Looker
description: Three of four models, who had plastic surgery done by Larry after a computed list, are dead. Neither the cops nor Larry believe they're suicides. Larry investigates and stays with the fourth model. Who's behind the lists and murders?

Title: 156. X-Ray
description: While receiving a routine check-up, a woman finds herself stranded on the hospital's eighth floor, while someone dressed as a doctor is intent on her never leaving, even if it means killing any staff member who comes into contact with her.

Title: 157. The Loveless
description: Trouble ensues when a motorcycle gang stops in a small southern town while heading to the races at Daytona.

Title: 158. Polyester
description: A suburban homemaker's world falls apart when she finds that her pornographer husband is serially unfaithful to her, her daughter is pregnant, and her son is suspected of being the foot-fetishist who's been breaking local women's feet.

Title: 159. Bloody Birthday
description: Three children are born at the height of an eclipse of the sun. Ten years later, they begin to murder the people around them - even their family members.

Title: 160. Nightmare
description: A mental patient embarks on a murder spree upon escaping from an institution.

Title: 161. Final Exam
description: An unknown, nameless psycho killer shows up on a college campus to slash up pretty co-eds and dumb jocks on the final day of exams.

Title: 162. Suddenly in the Dark
description: A wife starts to suspect her husband's infidelity after the arrival of their new, young housekeeper, who carries a mysterious wooden doll with herself.

Title: 163. Galaxy of Terror
description: A ragtag spaceship crew sent on a rescue mission encounter a formidable enemy, their worst fears projected by their own imaginations.

Title: 164. Pornô!
description: Collection of erotic stories that includes The Gazelles, The Pleasure of Virtue and The Grasshopper.

Title: 165. Bolero
description: The intertwined lives of three generations of musicians and dancers from Russia, Germany, France and the U.S., from before World War II through the war and the Holocaust, to the 1980s.

Title: 166. Mystics in Bali
description: A woman researches a book that takes her to the black magic cult of Leák in Bali. She meets an evil witch who promises to train her dark arts. But she is tricked and turned into a flying vampire with internal organs hanging from her neck.

Title: 167. Blood Wedding
description: A group of dancers puts Lorca's 'Blood Wedding' on stage, the tragic play about a married man who is still in love with his ex-girlfriend, and tries to reunite with her despite her planned wedding.

Title: 168. The Killing of America
description: A provocative examination of American society's capacity for extreme violence in an era bookended by the assassinations of John F. Kennedy and John Lennon.

Title: 169. Delusion

description: Disguised as ice cream vendors, Cheech and Chong make--and subsequently lose--millions of dollars selling a batch of marijuana with an unusual side effect.

Title: 232. The Aviator's Wife
description: A young student is devastated when he finds that his girlfriend is cheating on him. In order to find out why she did it, he decides to spy on her and her lover.

description: Chandramukhi visits Shimla and learns that she is a reincarnation of Paro, a girl who was raped and murdered. Plagued by her dark past, she attempts to bring the culprits to justice.

Title: 279. Vernon, Florida
description: A documentary on the eccentric residents of Vernon, Florida.

description: While inflicted with a powerful curse, a father murders his young daughter. A police detective travels to Thailand to investigate the father's reasoning, and becomes the target of a nasty sorcerer.

The crew is gobbled up one after another until the two surviving crewmembers come up with a plan.

description: A woman visits her former lesbian lover who's stuck in a boring marriage. They begin an affair. The lover's husband and his best friend are also having affairs - with each other's wives. The girls decide to seduce the other wife.

description: Spouses looking for silver in Mexico find a 300 year old severed hand driven by a demon.

description: A young man struggles to become a boxing champ, but success blinds him. It is only through the love of his girlfriend that he is brought back to reality.

description: The famous safecracker Kwinto, after leaving prison, decided to quit. But the news of the death of a friend abruptly changes his plans. He decides to "take" Kramer's bank. And, of course, he takes. Elegant, fun and twisted.

Was the thief who died in a trap set up by Louise's husband the same person, because of whom the girl jumped out of the window, and what will happen to herself when the book ends?

description: Chandran , a young man fools his boss and attempts to woo his boss' daughter.

description: A drunken deer hunter, his pilot colleague and his daughter compete with a treasure hunter to reach a lake in New Zealand and uncover a WWII-era plane wreck carrying a fortune in gold.

Title: 331. Swan Lake
description: A prince falls in love with a princess cursed to change into a swan by day, but their love is threatened by the sorcerer who keeps her imprisoned.

Title: 332. To Kill a Cop
description: Victim of manipulation, Cop Choucas is wanted for two murders and searched for by every cop in town.

Title: 333. Choice of Arms
description: The powerful story of a reformed underworld kingpin whose stable lifestyle is turned upside-down when a desperate, escaped killer hides out at his rural estate.

Title: 334. Separate Ways
description: A wife unhappy in her marriage begins an affair with an art student, unaware that her husband, a race driver, is also having an affair.

description: Barnaba, a rude bus driver who enjoys the attention of women, one day meets Principessa Cristina, the princess of a local principality.

description: Yuka Mitamura (Hiroko Yakushimaru) is a normal shy middle school student that has psychic powers. When a new student with similar powers begins to show her skills by stealing the student government election, Yuka and her friends vow to stop her. The election has uncovered something which will put Yuka's powers to the ultimate test.

Title: 337. The Mysterious Castle in the Carpathians
description: In 1897, in a castle near the town of Werewolfville in the Carpathians, a slightly deranged Professor Orfanik experiments with his new inventions which include, even at this early date, television and a film camera.

Title: 338. The War of the Worlds: Next Century
description: Film opens on December 28, 1999, three days before the dawn of the new century. A local reporter, Iron Idem, announces that the Martians have landed. Shortly after that his program loses its independence: he is given the script telling the crowds how to welcome the invaders. Then the chaos breaks out: the Martians and police mistreat the populace; things become violent. Idem's own wife is kidnapped and it seems somebody is trying to reduce his effectiveness as a reporter. Idem decides to fight back: he illegally broadcasts a message during a rock concert, but nobody believes him anymore.

Title: 339. C.O.D.
description: Albert Zack is a struggling, bumbling, advertising salesman hired to save the Beaver Bra Company from impending doom. He is charged with signing five specific, world-famous, busty woman as endorsers for the bra line. Silly antics and situations occur as he tries, mostly in various costumes, to get close enough to these women to make his pitch for their signature. Working against him are two board members who stand to gain if the company fails. As he circles the globe in search of these signatures, he is faced with a variety of challenges, one of which is a relationship with his own secretary.

Title: 340. Bonitinha Mas Ordinária ou Otto Lara Rezende
description: A rich man wants to pay one of his employees a lot of money to marry his daughter, who has been raped by five men. But something in the girl's story isn't quite right.

Title: 341. The Sex Sense
description: About a nymphomaniac and an artist that constantly spies on her.

Title: 342. Chashme Buddoor
description: Two womanizing slackers, Omi and Jai (Rakesh Bedi and Ravi Baswani respectively) attempt to woo the new girl in the neighbourhood, and fail - miserably. Their third room-mate, shy, and a bookworm - succeeds, much to their chargin. The two scheme up comical ideas to split the two lovebirds, so that their secrets and humiliation are not revealed.

Title: 343. Jaws of Satan
description: A preacher whose ancestors were cursed by Druids battles Satan, who has taken the form of a huge snake.

Title: 344. Smash Palace

Title: 345. Three Brothers
description: Three men face their mother's death.

Title: 346. The Queen of Black Magic
description: A woman is accused of being a witch and thrown to her death over a cliff. A strange man rescues her, nurses her back to health, and is told that she must master black magic in order to exact vengeance on her tormentors.

description: A scandal from Michael's past emerges when he visits his mother's house with the director and others from a recent film project.

Title: 348. The Salamander
description: An Italian policeman investigates murders of high-profile individuals, each scene marked by a salamander drawing. He uncovers a conspiracy to overthrow the government, connecting the murders to this sinister plot.

Title: 349. Centrespread
description: The Story of a photographer's struggle in the glamorous world of nude modeling.

Title: 350. Documenteur
description: A young French woman, separated from her lover, tries to find a lodging in L.A. for herself and her son.

Title: 351. Priest of Love
description: Following the banning and burning of his novel, "The Rainbow", D.H. Lawrence and his wife, Frieda, move to the United States, and then to Mexico. When Lawrence contracts tuberculosis, they return to England for a short time, then to Italy, where Lawrence wrote "Lady Chatterley's Lover".

Title: 352. Kranti
description: Sanga, a devout employee of Raja Laxman Singh, is falsely accused of killing him. He escapes prison and forms a group of revolutionaries with the sole aim of driving the British out of India.

Title: 353. Trohonomos... Varvara
description: An unemployed man realises that his striking resemblance to his twin sister, Varvara, could help him land a steady job. By donning her police uniform and a blonde wig, he gains entry to the Police Academy, surrounded by female recruits.

Title: 354. Image of the Beast
description: Third and best-known entry in the Mark IV series of fundamentalist apocalypse films. Fundamentalist Christian guerrilla David helps condemned dissidents escape, attempts to subvert the computerized Mark of the Beast, and generally tries to survive as prophecy unfolds in the rise of the Antichrist to the pinnacle of his power and the beginning of God's war on sinful man.

Title: 355. Lady of the Camelias
description: A young girl from the provinces, comes to Paris with one goal: to become a part of the rich bourgeoisie. To achieve this she will use her unique beauty and charm.

Title: 356. Ticket to Heaven
description: David is a young man seduced by a religious cult that uses starvation, exhaustion, and brainwashing to mold recruits into money hustling disciples of a messiah-like leader. Chronicles David's chilling transformation into a gaunt, mindless shadow of his former self...and his ultimate salvation when friends and family launch a plan to kidnap and deprogram him.

Title: 357. Deep Water
description: Melanie enjoys flirting and having little affairs. Her husband Victor seems to bear her antics with utmost calm and nonchalance. This impression turns out to be wrong, very wrong indeed.

Title: 358. Pacific Banana
description: Two Australian pilots, one a womanizer and the other seeking true love, work for a South Pacific airline, spending their time pursuing romantic interests on various Polynesian islands while neglecting their professional duties.

Title: 359. Yokohama BJ Blues
description: BJ is a relatively unknown blues singer who scraps some bars in Yokohama. He does not earn much with it and to make ends meet he also acts as a private detective.

Title: 360. Fantasma d'amore
description: Over two decades after their affair ended, a married man is haunted by the presence of his former lover.

Title: 361. The Best of Sex and Violence
description: Hosted by John Carradine, this tape is a compilation of scenes from and previews for various exploitation films.

Title: 362. The Bushido Blade
description: A steel samurai blade that was to be given to the American ambassador by the Emperor of Japan is stolen. American sailors and Japanese samurai are sent to find it.

Title: 363. The Marquis of Grillo
description: A mischievous nobleman and his poor doppelganger get into serious troubles when a practical joke endangers the Pope.

Title: 364. Was kostet der Sieg?
description: A school in Vienna is invited to a football tournament. The gym teacher and the selected students in the school's football team take it all very seriously. So serious that they become ambitious and put pleasure and friendship at stake.

Title: 365. A Sense of Freedom
description: The life and imprisonment of Glasgow hard man and gangster Jimmy Boyle.

Title: 366. 36 Chowringhee Lane
description: After marriage of her niece, Rosemary, Anglo-Indian school-teacher Violet Stoneham lives a lonely life in her single room flat located at 36 Chowringhee Lane in Calcutta.

description: Paris. In a nightclub, two girls, Annie and Pascale, follow two boys. They are drugged and wake up in a boat hold.

description: Germany 1935. 16-year old Sanne is sent to live with her aunt in Frankfurt. She falls in love with her cousin Franz, and they plan to marry secretly, but her aunt learns of the plans, and denounces Sanne to the Gestapo.

Title: 370. Day of the Idiots
description: Story of a mentally unstable woman who goes into an institution.

Title: 371. Soggy Bottom, U.S.A.
description: In a small Southern town, the local Sheriff tries to keep everything peaceful and under control.

Title: 372. Sobrenatural
description: The undesirable husband of a woman, after passing away, returns in spirit form to continue harassing and mistreating her. The woman asks for help from various friends and experts, but all efforts to defeat the devilish being seem futile.

Title: 373. Tuck Everlasting
description: In turn-of-the-20th-century upstate New York, Winnie Foster, a 12-year-old girl, discovers a family living in the woods near her family's home who never ages thanks to a magical spring they drink from and she is entrusted to keep their secret and becomes involved in their lives.

Title: 374. The House of God
description: Follow a group of interns in a large teaching hospital. When Chief Resident Jo has a breakdown, the interns are reluctantly placed under the tutelage of the senior resident, who's known as The Fatman. Like "M*A*S*H," "The Hospital," and "St. Elsewhere" (from which this story draws), this film is closer to the truth than the public wants to know.

Title: 375. Marianne & Juliane
description: Two sisters both fight for women's rights. Juliane is a journalist and Marianne a terrorist. When Marianne is jailed, Juliane feels obligated to help her despite their differing views on how to live.

Title: 376. Ek Duuje Ke Liye
description: The cross-cultural romance between Vaasu and Sapna meets heavy opposition from their family, who vow to stop their union at any cost. As the star-crossed lovers forbidden love ensues, nothing will prepare them for their tragic destiny.

Title: 377. From the Old Earth
description: As William Jones digs in the garden of his council house he finds a strange looking stone head

Title: 379. Te rompo el rating
description: A Buenos Aires television station tricks a competitor into hiring inept TV fan Jorge, hoping he will harm their ratings. Jorge accidentally ruins various broadcasts, but his buffoonish antics actually attract more viewers. Jorge and his assistant Moria inadvertently film a murder, and the criminals pursue them to obtain the incriminating footage.

Title: 380. Threshold
description: In this gripping sci-fi drama, a celebrated heart surgeon (Donald Sutherland, "The Hunger Games") collaborates with an offbeat scientist (Jeff Goldblum, "Jurassic Park") to perform the first artificial heart transplant.

Title: 381. Corpse Mania
description: A necrophiliac killer is murdering the prostitutes at Madame Lan's brothel.

Title: 382. Tragedy of a Ridiculous Man
description: An Italian businessman decides whether to pay a ransom for his abducted son or not.

description: This movie tells story of fierce and total competition of two related business families in the days of license raaj India. The overall plot is based on Mahabharat. This movie shows that how the pursuit of self serving ideals even legitimizes killing of family members.

Title: 384. Pierino contro tutti
description: Pierino is a precocious but mischievous boy who often plays pranks and makes jokes at school. His enemy is his old teacher. One day Pierino pulls a dirty trick on her, making her break an arm.

Title: 385. To the Stars by Hard Ways
description: A female creature created in space tries to live on earth and has special (and sometimes dangerous) powers.

Title: 386. Violación inconfesable
description: A husband sexually exploits his wife, forcing her to perform all kinds of sexual acts.

Title: 387. The Demon
description: Random people are terrorized by a malevolent man wearing a black leather glove with razor-fingers, who brings their worst fears to life.

Title: 388. Madame Olga's Pupils
description: Madame Olga is the owner of a luxurious brothel in London. When one of her girls dies while with a client, a young man, Rafael, girl's friend comes and asks about her death. But soon he starts to work for Olga as a pimp. When he meets Lavinia, one of Olga's girls he falls in love with her. But when she resists him in bed, he sleeps with her mother Betty.

Title: 389. El crack
description: Private detective Germán Areta gets a terminally ill client who wishes to see his long lost, runaway daughter before he dies. But when Areta starts looking into case, it leads him to the dark underbelly of Madrid where he finds that he is not only one looking for the girl. Someone else is also interested in her, someone powerful and dangerous who will stop at nothing to prevent Areta from discovering the truth..

Title: 390. A Day of Judgment
description: In the 1920s, a man in black rides into a small Southern town to visit retribution upon the citizens who have strayed from the path of righteousness and religion. He does this, of course, by killing them in various bloody ways.

Title: 391. Y'ur Height Only
description: The diminutive Agent 00 must rescue a kidnapped scientist and stop a mysterious warlord from taking over the world.

Title: 392. Frankenstein Island
description: When a hot air balloon crashes on a remote island, the crew discovers Dr. Frankenstein's descendant, Dr. Sheila Frankenstein. carrying on the family work, along with a race of mutants and a population of Amazon warriors.

Title: 393. Yaarana
description: Bishan loses his fortune while helping his friend Kishan in his singing career. Now successful, would Kishan return the favour?

Title: 394. Zoom Up: The Beaver Book Girl
description: After a young woman is viciously assaulted in an abandoned factory building, her attacker runs off, leaving a roll of money. Several years pass, and a photographer who specializes in shooting "schoolgirl panty" photos for the adult entertainment industry meets a sexy but mysterious woman who asks to be his next model. He doesn't know that she has a dark secret, and he may soon find out more about it than he would want to know.

Title: 395. Lovely But Deadly
description: A cheerleader goes undercover to fight drug dealers because her brother OD'd and her fellow cheerleaders are hooked.

Title: 396. On the Right Track
description: Lester is a homeless shoeshine boy living in a railway station. He's got this funny knack for picking the winning horses' names out of the paper while shining shoes. When word gets around, though, everyone wants a piece of the action.

Title: 397. Circle of Deceit
description: A German journalist, escaping from broken marriage, goes to Lebanon to cover the civil war. Soon, he realizes that he can't handle the truth.

Title: 398. Home Sweet Home
description: An escaped mental patient steals a station wagon and makes his way to the Bradleys' Thanksgiving celebration, where he plans to make them a little less thankful...

Title: 400. I Love It from Behind!
description: A young girl has been collecting "penis prints" since high school, and is determined to amass 100 prints before her arranged marriage comes up in a month. She manages to collect 99 prints, but the 100th proves to be the most difficult, as her subject makes a deal with her that turns out to be harder than she thought it would be.

Title: 401. Savage Harvest
description: A family in Africa finds itself under attack by a pride of lions.

Title: 402. Gangster Wars
description: Three poor ghetto kids in turn-of-the-century New York City grow up to become feared gangsters.

description: In the interior of São Paulo, an apparently normal family hides unexpected secrets. One of the members makes sex her only weapon to get what she wants in this plot full of revenge, prejudice and contestation of values.

description: Lydie, a physically unattractive young woman, is brutally dumped by her fiance when she had just acquired the lease of an apartment to live with him.

description: Jaka Sembung is the leader of the rebel and a famous fighter that inspires people to fight the Dutch Colonial Government. The Dutch representative in Java offers a reward for his death and employs another mighty warrior to go after him.

Title: 406. Strange Affair
description: Louis, a young advertising executive, is entrusted with more and more responsibilities by his new director. To the point that, neglecting his wife Nina, she eventually leaves him.

Title: 407. Paul Raymond's Erotica
description: Brigitte Lahie stars as a stunning French reporter who Paul Raymond personally invites into Soho's sleaziest sex locales. This experience convinces the young woman that she wants to be a stripper too.

Title: 408. Choices
description: John Carluccio, a partially deaf teen faces obstacles pursuing football due to his disability. He navigates relationships with family, coach, teammates, girlfriend and questionable peers, ultimately challenging the school board's decision.

Title: 409. My Young Auntie
description: A young country bumpkin marries a dying man, so that he can keep his estate from falling into the hands of his brother. She travels to her nephew-in-law to deliver her husband's will to him, and butt heads with his college educated son.

Title: 410. Raaz
description: A woman traveling on a train witnesses a murder.

Title: 411. Rubber Tarzan
description: A weak, dyslexic boy is bullied in school. His Tarzan obsessed dad calls him Rubber Tarzan. He makes a friend in crane driver Ole, who tells him: There's always something, you're good at. You just have to know what it is.

Title: 412. Night of the Zombies
description: Investigators search for soldiers' missing bodies, and hear unbelievable rumors about zombies. Dismissing those rumors they set out to investigate. After two men are found dead, CIA special-agent Nick Monroe is sent to flush out what are suspected to be deserters from the old U.S. Army Chemical Corps unit. Nick's ruthless investigation uncovers a ghoulish plot of world domination, but first he must escape the horror that does not want to be known... yet!

Title: 413. Malevil
description: A group of ordinary French survived a nuclear war and found themselves in the face of what was left of civilization.

Title: 414. Why Not?
description: Near the turbulent end of the Edo era, a man returning to Japan after exile in America searches for his wife and becomes swept up in the current of revolution in this incisive period drama from the great Shohei Imamura.

Title: 415. Heat of Desire
description: Serge Laine, a scholar leading a simple life with his wife, suddenly leaves everything behind to follow Caroline, a beautiful adventurer.

Title: 416. Spaghetti a mezzanotte
description: Savino La Gastra discovers his wife Celeste has a liaison with an architect: Andrea. Even if also Savino has a story with Elvira, a judge's wife, he decides anyway to ask to a mobster to kill his wife. In the mean time Celeste is organizing a surprise party for Savino's birthday, and that day things start to get complicated. First Savino kills accidentally the mafia killer in charge to kill Celeste; second his lover Elvira arrives to the party with the judge... not to mention the police and the mafia Don...

Title: 417. Freak Orlando
description: In the form of a "small theater of the world", a history of the world from its beginnings to our day, including the errors, the incompetence, the thirst for power, the fear, the madness, the cruelty and the commonplace, in a story of five episodes.

Title: 418. Circle of Power
description: A group of husbands with their wives participate in a reunion where everybody will find his hidden secret. The methods used are terrible, but usually work. Just usually.

Title: 419. Jailhouse Wardress
description: After the fall of the Third Reich, all Nazi SS officers ran away in Latin American countries. They created special laboratories to create beautiful women for satisfaction of their sexual desires. The main warden is a cruel woman.

Title: 420. Bianco, rosso e Verdone
description: On Election Day, three Italians travel to their hometowns to vote.

Title: 421. Longshot
description: Leif Garrett is a young foosball player who wants to earn the big dollars that will be used to play soccer in Europe by winning the foosball world championships.

Title: 422. Tristan and Isolde
description: The young knight Tristan is injured in a fight in Ireland and cared for by the beautiful Isolde. He falls in love with her, unaware that she is the daughter of the Irish king.

Title: 423. Lunch Wagon
description: The fun begins when Marcy and Shannon decide to work away their summer vacation on a lunch wagon given to them by a friend. Hoods ditch a $50,000 diamond in their mustard, and the lunch wagon is kidnapped. The race to the rescue is on.

Title: 424. Rasmus and the Vagabond
description: Rasmus lives at an orphanage. He's OK, but wants a mom and a dad, and from time to time some comes to find a child, but they always chose little girls curls. Rasmus realizes he has to run away and find parents himself.

Title: 425. Tik Tik Tik
description: A fashion photographer gets embroiled in a series of grisly murders

Title: 426. Vecinos
description: Luis and Aurora live around Madrid. Their life is quiet and peaceful until it comes Antonio, their new neighbor. Luis thinks that neighbors are the usual bores that turn music up, do not greet and always call at inopportune times to ask for something. However, Aurora considers them friendly, helpful and willing to help in whatever it takes. But things get complicated when Aurora and Antonio strike up a friendly relationship.

Title: 427. The Tyrant's Heart
description: A historical drama set in the 1400s, about a young man sent to Italy but is forced back after his father's mysterious death.

Title: 428. Firebird 2015 AD
description: In one of many unpopular and unsupported policy decisions, the US government of the near future outlaws vehicle petrol in an effort to curb the overuse of limited natural resources - except, of course, for official purposes. There are many renegades who oppose the authorities, and will stop at nothing to allow themselves the freedom of burning around the countryside.

Title: 429. Underground Aces
description: The escapades of a crew of zany parking lot attendants.

Title: 430. Mobile Suit Gundam II: Soldiers of Sorrow
description: After attacks by Char and Garma, White Base crew battle Zeon forces through Asia, Europe, Atlantic on way to Federation HQ. Crewmembers like Amuro, Bright, Kai, Sayla, Mirai, Fraw, Hayato overcome fears, losses to survive.

Title: 431. The Fantastic Adventures of Unico
description: When Unico, a young unicorn, is taken from his family by evil gods, his powers of joy and happiness are put to the test. Can Unico's power triumph the darkness?

Title: 432. Davaro
description: Memo returns from Germany to get married with his love but his father's killer Sulo is released from jail. In accordance with the blood feud, he has to get revenge for his father or he can not get married but he doesn't want to kill so they stage a fake death with Sulo and after that his luck runs out.

Title: 433. Ojo por ojo
description: Una pareja de estudiantes de medicina es atacada por los matones del pueblo. Después del suicidio de su mujer, el esposo jura vengarse de sus atacantes.

Title: 434. Sexo Profundo
description: Wealthy Silvia is married to unfaithful Alexandre. She catches her husband red-handed with a woman in a nightclub and Alexandre promises a new start for the couple. Silvia is upset and decides to fly in her airplane, but the weather is not suitable and she returns to her farm. She surprises Alexandre in a compromising position with her seventeen year-old sister. Silvia sends her husband away and puts her sister in a boarding school. Silvia meets Alexandre and sleeps with him. Out of the blue, she castrates her husband with a razor blade and chains him in the attic with an opening to her bedroom. Then Silvia brings every man and woman in the neighborhood to have sex with her and to excite her husband, who becomes desperate with his libido. In the end, she crashes her plane into the farmhouse.

Title: 435. Cactus Girl
description: A wealthy and lustful commander, a foolish friend, a "sexy" secretary, and a short-sighted and meddlesome wife are the ingredients of this comedy, set on the island of Rhodes.

Title: 436. Thrilling Bloody Sword
description: A princess living in the woods falls in love with a sword-wielding prince.

Title: 437. The Orchard End Murder
description: In 1966, a woman has an enigmatic interaction with a stationmaster and his aide, setting off an intriguing chain of events that unfolds throughout the narrative.

Title: 438. Kopaszkutya
description:
A Hungarian band plays American rock & roll and blues hits with great enthusiasm and passion, but success seems to avoid them. TV and radio don't play their songs, sometimes even their crowd just sits and sips beer.

Something must be done, and the band's promoter/agent (played by Lóránt Schuszter) comes up with the big idea: write and play songs for the people about themselves and not about some exotic, but too distant people's life.

"We move from Tobacco Road to Retek street" that is the summary of his revolutionary idea that connects the music roots to the new content of the lyrics to be.

With the remains of the band and a second singer (Gyula Deák "Bill") they find what they failed to show people before. The rich new sound can finally translate the spirit of blues and rock much more than words from any dictionaries could, this is the Köbánya-blues. The fans - who are mostly young people - love the band and some fans even write admiring letters to the band. They feel they are on the right track for a career.

They fire the promoter who takes back the dog - that should have been the image of the band and who induced the title song of the movie - to the dog home after the had fired him as promoter.

The band continues to play in venues in front of new audience that is a promising path to a career. The band is going to strive for perfection of their newly found path to reach people with real stories in their songs that connect to people through similarities with their lives.

Title: 439. Chanel Solitaire
description: This movie tells the story of the early life and rise to fame and fortune of French fashion designer Gabrielle "Coco" Chanel (Marie-France Pisier), beginning with her upbringing in an orphanage and training as a milliner, but concentrating on her relationship with Etienne de Balsan (Rutger Hauer) and her tempestuous love affair with his friend Boy Capel (Timothy Dalton), and the role the two men played in setting her up as an independent business woman.

Title: 440. La pulquería
description: The devil comes to Earth in hopes of experiencing true love.

Title: 441. Night of Horror
description: Four friends are stranded on what was once an old civil war battle ground and are haunted by the souls of those who died there.

Title: 442. Love Massacre
description: The story of a young co-ed whose boyfriend turns into a demented stalker after the suicide of his sister.

Title: 443. Be Pretty and Shut Up!
description: Famous actresses talk about their role in the movie industry, and the demand to "be beautiful and shut up".

Title: 444. Kopfschuß
description: "Headshot" - Annie is a cashier in a Munich Cinema Center. Her everyday life is the complete opposite of the exciting screen adventures she sells at the box office, so she fantasizes about the movies during the day. At night, she also begins to stage her own adventure in real life and is increasingly looking for danger and thrills.

Title: 445. Rocky
description: Shankar a union leader looses his life in accident at work site while he was fighting with his boss Ratanlal for rights of workers,Ratanlal decides to agree on Shankar's demands after his death with due respect.But JD and Ram Avtar aren't happy with his decision and kill him unlike Shankar.Shankar's friend Robert Dsouza decides to support his family but JD starts to eye Shankar's widow Parvati and tries to molest her,while trying to save his mother Shankar's son Rakesh hurts himself and goes in trauma.Rakesh whenever sees his mother gets the same vision and looses his control so Robert and his wife Katy decide to adopt him and name him Rocky Dsouza.Years later Rocky has grown up to be a handsome guy and falls in love with Renu daughter of Ratanlal while on trip to Srinagar but Renu mistakes him to be RD son of JD until the truth is out.Rocky and Renu fall in love and RD tries to creates hurdles where Rocky also finds that JD was responsible for spoiling their life and killing his father.

Title: 446. Bloody Sex

Title: 447. L'année prochaine... si tout va bien
description: Faced with Maxime's refusal to want a child, Isabelle leaves him and goes to live with François. The young couple reconcile and get married. Isabelle becomes pregnant. When an admirer of Maxime's appears, Isabelle, jealous, runs away.

Title: 448. Kamilla
description: A young girl growing up in Bergen, Norway just after the 2nd world war, is trying to deal with the father's adultery and mother's deep depression, as she befriends a boy. This endangers her.

Title: 449. Banovic Strahinja
description: In late 14th century medieval Serbia becomes the target of Ottoman invaders. One of their renegade gangs burns the castle and takes young wife of Banovic Strahinja, respected Serbian noble. Banovic Strahinja begins long and almost futile quest for his wife despite everybody else's doubts in her fidelity.

Title: 450. Blue Lagoon: A Summer Experience
description: With summer vacation, Chiaki, a high school girl, is just passing each day without getting along well with her boyfriend, Masahiko and her first experience.

Title: 451. Sweet Dreams
description: Michele criticizes the film industry and its inhabitants, and is particularly embattled with a Neapolitan director making a musical about the 1968 student demonstrations. At the same time, Michele has a creative block and struggles to finish his film titled "Freud's Mother."

Title: 452. Baseraa
description: Sharda and her sister Poornima alias Nima live with their widowed father. Since both have come of age, he first arranges Sharda's marriage with a businessman named Balraj Kohli. Subsequently, Poornima also marries a wealthy young man. But fate has other plans for Nima, for her husband tragically passes away in an accident, leaving her widowed. When Sharda sees her sister in a widow's garb, she loses her mental balance and is institutionalized in Pune Mental Hospital. After approximately 14 years, an inmate strikes Sharda on her head, she loses consciousness for several days. When she regains her senses, she remembers everything that happened 14 years ago, but is unable to recollect her life in the mental hospital. Her treating psychiatrist is ready to discharge her to the care of her husband and her family. Sharda comes home, everything is about the same, except that her son, Sagar, has grown up and is about to be engaged to Sarita Sethi, and Nima still wears a widow's garb. A few months later Sharda sees Nima clad in a colorful saree, wearing a bindiya with sindoor in her forehead, and starts suspecting that everything is not it seems to be. She then finds out that Balraj had re-married and also has a son from his second marriage named Babbu. As details come flooding into her she experiences wild paranoia, is unable to trust anyone, as no one is what they claim to be, and she feels alone, lost, helpless, and distrustful. The rest of the family hover around - waiting to see what the new outcome is to be with Sharda and her struggle to fit into a family that has not been her's for 14 years.

Title: 453. Lifepod
description: The first interplanetary cruise ship malfunctions halfway to Jupiter, forcing most of the crew and passengers to abandon ship. A handful of people are trapped onboard.

Title: 455. Clara and the Why Not
description: Three days in the lives of six friends who are nearly 30 years old, live in Grenoble, and have a rock band called the "Why Notes?". They're to play in Paris at Charles's school reunion. In getting to Paris and back, the characters interact with Aimee's ex-husband and her abrasive, cruel ex-mentor, Louise's would-be lover who turns out to have a husband, Mickey's long-time lover and her children, Bertrand's Germanic wife and their children who speak no French, and Frederic's distant mother. The band also meets Clara, a mercurial free spirit who beguiles Bertrand, then Mickey, then takes up with someone else in the band.

Title: 456. Black Mirror
description: A downbeat story of life inside a women's prison. There is more crime inside than out. When the inmates see that a woman is soon to be admitted for killing a young boy, they begin to plan her murder.

Title: 457. Wardat
description: Locust attack has created havoc in some villagers where crops are being destroyed and human life is in danger Anand and Rosie who are investigating the case get killed by Shakti.The chief officer then decides to appoint his smart officer Gopi (Gunsmaster G 9) on the mission,Gopi is in holiday mood and in no mood to take the case.But soon Gopi returns back and finds some grains bought by assistant Kabaadi which relates to weaken immune system of human body.Shakti and his associates mixes these grains with a substance which makes human body addicted to it and weakens their immune.Shakti also makes Anand's sister Dr Anuradha believe that Gopi killed her brother and asks her to seduce him for revenge.But Gopi is smart enough to to understand he finds that the locust attack is not natural but controlled by a force and Shakti is not the head of the gang but its operated by a scientific mastermind.

Title: 458. I'm Starting from Three
description: Gaetano, a young Neapolitan, tired of his life, moves to Florence in search of new opportunities and experiences. After his arrival, he meets Marta, a young woman, and falls for her.

Title: 459. Chu Chu and the Philly Flash
description: Flash used to be a talented baseball player, but he took to drinking and now he sells stolen watches in the streets. One day he meets Chu Chu, who, before falling into alcoholism like him, was a successful entertainer. Now she still dances, but in the streets, for no more than a cent or two. Luck seems to smile at them the day they find stolen government documents forgotten some place. They decide to return them to their legal owners, but instead of the expected reward money, all they get is a load of trouble.

Title: 460. Cutting it Short
description: An evocation of the childhood memories of Bohumil Hrabal in his provincial town of Nymburk, dominated by the local brewery.

Title: 461. Your Neighbor's Son
description: The documentary dramatizes the recruiting and training of a young men into the Greek police during the 1967-1974 military junta rule. Seemingly decent young men are selected based on traits viewed as exploitable by the recruiters : illiterate, anti-communist, young and male. The film interviews Michailis Petrou, one of the Greek policeman involved in the tortures who agreed to testify against his peers in exchange for a reduced sentence. Petrou's testimony reveals that the training methods themselves were brutal and often torturous and was viewed as a necessity to ensure the robotic and brutal obedience of the trainees. During the dramatic reenactments of the training camps, the directors draw parallels to modern military boot camps and the methods used in the training of soldiers.

Title: 462. Adieu Galaxy Express 999
description: Set two years after the events of Galaxy Express 999, Tetsuro fights as a rebel on a war-torn Earth before boarding the Three-Nine once more.

Title: 463. My Wife Goes Back to School
description: Aristide Buratti is a wealthy grocer married to attractive Valentina. Although they seem to have a happy marriage, Valentina feels herself culturally inferior because she is a high school dropout. Despite her husband's objections, she enrolls at a private boarding school.

Title: 464. Nobody's Perfekt
description: The story of a group of misfits living in Miami, and their revenge against government bureaucracy. After the city refuses to pay for the damage to their car caused by a pothole, the three friends, including one with constant short-term memory loss and another who is always jumping from personality to personality, decide to steal an army howitzer and 'persuade' the mayor to change his mind.

Title: 465. Fangs
description: An Egyptian remake of "The Rocky Horror Picture Show" completely reinvents O'Brien's classic, refocusing his efforts on a horde of flamboyant vampires who enjoy nothing more than a sing-along.

Title: 466. The Promising Boy
description: A normal boy receives a blow to the head which sets him off to do rebellious acts.

Title: 467. Les Filles de Copacabana
description: Three students Juanita, Jean and Hans bored with their life in Paris go to Brazil in search of sexual adventures.

Title: 468. Maria, Mirabella
description: Two sisters go to the fairy to help the little inhabitants of the forest. Musical film-tale with animation.

Title: 469. Masked Avengers
description: After a few of their members are violently killed, a righteous martial arts clan travels to a town where a highly secretive and brutal gang hideout is located. Once there, they have to investigate the locals to identify the gang's leaders.

Title: 470. Engraçadinha
description: Engraçadinha is a sexy teenager, with whom every man wants to get involved, except her cousin Sílvio, the only man she loves. On Sílvio's engagement day, she seduces him at the party and becomes pregnant. But her father, Dr. Arnaldo, tells her a horrible secret, saying that her child cannot be born. A tragedy ensues.

Title: 471. Khara Khota
description: Raj Bahadur a rich man and elite of city had an affair with a young, beautiful, poor girl Reshma, who becomes pregnant and is left to race the consequences by herself. Rajni, wife of R.B. comes to know about this and wants to rectify her husbands mistake by secretly helping Reshma through one man Mr. Mathur who is kind-hearted and a human first. R.B. comes to know about the secret meeting of his wife & Mr. Mathur. Black shadows of doubt of infidelity of his wife creeps in his mind and he asks her to leave him forever. Vishwas, young son of R.B. condemns this but his mother asks him to wait and wait for the day when he can prove to his father that the blood flowing in his body is R.B.'s own and she goes away to commit suicide. A wall of hatred is built-up between father & son. R.B. falls for a greedy, sex-hungry, young girl Shalini and marries her. Now Shalini wants to kill R.B. to get all his wealth, but Vishwas every time manages to foil all her schemes. One day Shalini is found dead on her bed with blood all over the bed. This death proclaimed as murder and investigation starts. Investigating officer Sandeep smells foul in the house only and suspects as why Vishwas, though being innocent has taken over the charge on his head. During the course of investigation, Sandeep confirms that Vishwas is innocent and the murder was committed by someone else. . R.B. comes to know that Vishwas has taken the blame on his head because he thought that R.B. must have committed this murder. R.B's heart fills with love for Vishwas and he gets him released from the jail.

Title: 472. Erotic Escape
description: The daughter of a rich farmer is kidnapped by a fugitive. She is raped and brutalized but finally gets her revenge.

Title: 473. Beautiful, Blondes and Tanned
description: Mistaken for bank robbers, two friends stumble into a group of beautiful girls and follow them to Morocco for a dance show.

Title: 474. Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Devil's Wedding Night
description: Two brothers seek a mystical ring at Castle Dracula in Transylvania, encountering a countess who needs one for blood and another to host her lover's spirit.

Title: 475. The Hot Touch
description: A master art forger and his partner in crime, an art expert who can vouch for the authenticity of the forgeries, are making a bundle. An art dealer figures out their scheme but agrees to keep quiet if they forge some art lost in WWII.

Title: 476. Assassination Attempt
description: Alain Delon and Claude Jade stars in this Soviet movie: Documents reveal in 1980 that the Germans planned to kill the Big Three in Teheran in 1943.

Title: 477. Not a Love Story: A Film About Pornography
description: Documentary about the pornography industry and the apparent violent anti-woman slant much of it takes.

Title: 478. La caduta degli angeli ribelli
description: Who is the mysterious stranger Cecilia met on the street? Why is he suspicious of everyone? She is happily married, has a lovely child and an interesting job: she has no motive to be troubled, but she decides to join him and to become his lover. She shares his destiny right up to its unexpected conclusion.

Title: 479. Violence and Flesh
description: Three criminals escape from prison and break in a seaside house to wait for the getaway boat. They subdue four aspirant actresses and three men and rape and torture them. One of the escapees is an idealistic political prisoner that falls in love with Letícia. When the violent Jorge kills a woman camped on the beach, the police investigate the area.

Title: 480. La desnuda chica del relax
description: Three young robbers and drug addicts cause mayhem.

Title: 481. Hear the Song of the Wind
description: A student travels back to Kobe for the summer. Once there, he meets his friend Rat, hangs on the usual place, listening to the Beach Boys and meets a mysterious twin girl.

Title: 482. A Limousine the Colour of Midsummer's Eve
description: The struggle of two related families for the eighty-year-old aunt's inheritance through comic and romantic events.

Title: 483. Love Story
description: A carefree son of a wealthy builder and an overprotected daughter of a rich father elope from their homes and end up falling for each other not aware of their parents unresolved past.

Title: 484. Francisca
description: The life of a young man, son of an English officer who lets himself become a prisoner of love resulting in fatalism and disgrace.
